maya: quick note from compact-sprint q4 canary: mixed CJK + RTL samples show punctuation mirroring + stray zero-width chars in some decodes. short stats: fp32 BLEU 30.2 -> q4 BLEU 25.1 on mixed-orient subset.

maya: minimal repro: (\u4f60\u597d) \u2014 \u0627\u0644\u0633\u0644\u0627\u0645 [\u4e16\u754c]
fp32 decode: "(\u4f60\u597d) \u2014 \u0627\u0644\u0633\u0644\u0627\u0645 [\u4e16\u754c]"
q4 decode: ")\u4f60\u597d( \u2014 \u200f\u0627\u0644\u0633\u0644\u0627\u0645 ]\u4e16\u754c["  (paren swapped, U+200F inserted)

cheng: did q4 bundle change pre-normalize? last time pre-normalize=false caused bidi glitches. i'll diff tokenizer.json + unicode lib.

li-wei: quick token dump: sentencepiece -> ['(', '\u4f60\u597d', ')', ' ', '\u2014', ' ', '\u0627\u0644\u0633\u0644\u0627\u0645', ' ', '[', '\u4e16\u754c', ']']
q4 runtime tokenizers -> ['(', '\u200e', '\u4f60\u597d', ')', ' ', '\u2014', ' ', '\u200f', '\u0627\u0644\u0633\u0644\u0627\u0645', ' ', '[', '\u200e', '\u4e16\u754c', ']']
(looks like LRMs/RLMs inserted around boundary)

sahil: running q4 with --no-compact-emit; tokens match fp32. with compact-emit enabled I see 0xE2 0x80 0x8E/8F bytes at chunk boundaries. bisecting fused-emit commit.

eval-bot: CI scan https://ci.redwood/run/9901 flagged mixed-orientation delta BLEU -5.1. artifacts attached.

maya: action list: 1) @cheng confirm pre-normalize diff, 2) @li-wei run full mixed subset against small repro and paste dumps, 3) @sahil continue bisect and try quick revert in q4 canary, 4) i'll file INF-1504 and attach samples. if tokenization-only fix (force NFKC pre-tokenize) recovers outputs we may gate by locale.

cheng: pushed branch fix/pre-nfkc-tokenize (PR #3609) to test.

li-wei: validating PR + will run 1k mixed samples. gist: https://gist.github.com/li-wei/q4-bidi-minirepro

sahil: bisect shows commit 7f4e introduced tail-write marker; reverting on canary fixes decodes but adds ~1.5% p95 latency. recommending revert + locale-gated pre-normalize until we push proper kernel fix.

maya: thanks all. keep replies short here; i'll update INF-1504 with root cause and mitigation once validated. :thumbsup:
